[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابمايكونماقبلالمحلوفبهعوضامناللفظبالواو)#636/r11] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | After a completed oath clause, a break makes the later oath independent; without a break its noun is genitive by coordination with the first oath noun.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابمايكونماقبلالمحلوفبهعوضامناللفظبالواو)#636/r12] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | When the second oath noun is delayed until after a second verb, the verbs are coordinated first and the delayed oath is separate.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابمايكونماقبلالمحلوفبهعوضامناللفظبالواو)#636/r13] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | A delayed oath noun remains coordinated and genitive when it is linked to the first oath noun and no clause follows to detach it.
[SIBAWAYH:(هذابابمايكونماقبلالمحلوفبهعوضامناللفظبالواو)#636/r14] SIBAWAYH, d. 180 · author | holds | Do not separate a genitive from its coordinating particle; Sibawayh compares this to separating a preposition from its coordinated noun.
